title: Someone built a free plugin that lets Claude control almost any app on your computer
description:
You keep waiting for the apps you use to release an official AI integration. Most of them never will. This free plugin makes that wait pointless.

It's called CLI Anything. You point it at any app or repo on your computer, and it reads the code, writes the commands, and installs everything automatically. No docs, no manual setup.

After that your agent can actually run the thing. Blender, Premiere Pro, Zoom, even NotebookLM, straight from your terminal. And because it all runs as command line tools, your agent uses far fewer tokens than a stack of MCPs would.

It's a universal remote for your AI. If it has a terminal or an API, this can probably talk to it.

Comment CLI and I'll send you the link.

#claudecode #claudeai #cli #aitools #aiagents #mcp #automation #buildwithai #aiworkflow #developertools
